title: Red Hat Security Advisory: grafana security update
description: Red Hat has issued a security advisory for Grafana addressing two vulnerabilities. The first (CVE-2026-88967) involves the Azure Monitor data source potentially leaking its Azure access token. The second (CVE-2026-116591) is a denial of service vulnerability in the klauspost/compress zstd compression library via crafted input. These issues affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support and related variants. Updates are available to remediate these vulnerabilities.
